steps.content: [Hypatia's Room]

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: You should be ashamed of yourself! The Campbell name is not yours to disgrace so carelessly.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I... I am very sorry.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: For the next several days, you will remain at home, reflecting on your actions, and compose a thorough report on the Aurum Secretum Apostle. The Senate is eager to hear your findings. Consider this your final opportunity to redeem yourself.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: Hypatia... You are this family's most treasured daughter. Do not disappoint us.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I will heed your counsel with the utmost respect.
After ending the internal comms, Hypatia exhales sharply and sags against her desk, the weight of exhaustion pressing down on her.
Yesterday's infiltration could hardly be called a success, yet it wasn't a complete failure, either. The guards had arrived late enough for her to skim nearly every classified file.
She draws another steadying breath, recalling the keywords she has hastily glimpsed. Just the thought of them sends an involuntary tremor through her fingers.
The Underground, inheritance... trans-calamity communications, Project BR-005... Deliberate detonation of a Black Ring within Fraser... creation of Fraser's own Hypercube mines...
Each line is more horrifying than the last. The scale of the sacrifice—how many lives would it consume?

She had only ever known these technologies in fragments, isolated pieces of a puzzle she never imagined would form something this monstrous. A conspiracy vast enough to swallow the entire farlands whole.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Now the question is... how to get this information out...

The Aurum Secretum she carries has been completely confiscated. All communication signals are blocked—she's permitted only the internal telephone. Under house arrest, she is nearly severed from the outside world.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But there aren't many guards... An oversight? Do they assume I've no will to escape?
Indeed, the Hypatia of old would never have defied her family. Yet now, the thought lingers—who planted it there? What would she do in this situation?

In the blind spot of surveillance, she slides the chip from her palm to her wrist, tucking it into her sleeve. As she sits, her fingers brush the desk's edge, retrieving a communicator wedged deep in the crack.
A moment later, Hypatia stands up and picks up the internal telephone again.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Hello, could you please connect me to Miss Jacqueline Schneider? This is Hypatia Campbell calling.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm inquiring about her civilian Aurum Secretum project. If she's available, I'd appreciate a moment of her time today.
[Manor Exterior]
Shortly after, a sleek silver-white sports car drives through the gates of Campbell Manor.

steps.speaker: Jacqueline
steps.content: Hypatia! I rushed over the second I got your message. Oh, and just look at this car. Absolutely stunning, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's an exquisite design. The exterior alone makes quite a statement.

steps.speaker: Jacqueline
steps.content: It's our newest model. The official launch isn't even until next month! You know how my family's always dreamed of working some Aurum Secretum magic into our designs.

steps.speaker: Jacqueline
steps.content: But the Senate guards that technology like dragons hoarding gold. We minor nobles might as well be asking for the moon! So here I am, turning to an old classmate for help!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Hehe, the Institute has recently initiated a limited technology transfer program, an effort to collaborate with noble houses on certain... specialized breakthroughs. Naturally, you were the first person who came to mind.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Well then, shall we continue this conversation inside? You may leave the car here.
Several dozen minutes later.
A shadowy figure crouches low, slinking toward the sleek sports car. A key—the key, rightfully belonging to the car's owner—slides into the ignition.
The door swings open. Hypatia slips inside, adjusts the seat with practiced ease, and scans the controls. Her fingers tighten around the steering wheel. A slow, steadying breath. Then—
BOOM!

steps.speaker: Manor Guard
steps.content: Damn it, what's going on with that car... Hey, stop her!
With the accelerator floored, the silver beast rockets forward, tires screeching as it blasts through the manor gates.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Forgive me, Jacqueline... I promise I'll make time to help you with that technology sharing later. But just this once, let me borrow your car for one day!
The wheel jerks hard right. The sports car obeys without hesitation, roaring away from Fraser City.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The jamming should stop here. Please, you have to answer me, Hella!
